correctness.rationale: A concrete signature-preserving four-move EF strategy is proved using surjectivity of symplectic linear functionals. The only missing fourth-point types occur on selected isotropic lines at q=2,d=2 and for independent triples with a prescribed kernel projective point or an exhausted binary fiber; all depend only on the indicated two dichotomies. Two explicit depth-four properties separate them. The verification source performs exact finite extension-profile comparisons for eight graph models including F4.

value.rationale: Natural, complete bounded-depth logical invariant of a classical polar geometry graph family: precisely two independently detectable phenomena (Witt rank and field size) arise together at the first distinguishing depth, with a sharp 364-vertex representative kernel. It differs meaningfully from a routine exact small-graph table, and the cross-field phase cannot be inferred from the known binary case alone.
